dogecoin.text: Verge was first launched in October 2014 as DogeCoinDark (DOGED), a fork of Peercoin (PPC). In February 2016, it was rebranded to Verge (#XVG) to distinguish itself from Dogecoin (#DOGE) and for easier mass-market adoption. The project is now based on the Bitcoin source code. https://t.co/0urBzQLuk8
